observations: remove_waiter derives the task pointer from SP_EL0 before lock/dequeue/clear/unlock; pointer origin matches ARM64 current convention.
The early cleanup clear is based on that current-derived pointer, not a waiter-task-derived pointer.
rt_mutex_start_proxy_lock contains direct calls to the same cleanup function.
confidence_scope: Audited current-derived cleanup and direct proxy caller; not a complete mitigation audit or exploitability test.
limitations: No exploit construction, runtime address recovery, structure-layout adaptation or device execution.
Other equivalent mitigations in unaudited paths are not ruled out.
CFI symbol presence is not proof that every jump-table label targets its apparent function.
